answer: Resist sybils with a time-locked contribution bond that bends like a willow instead of snapping. 1) Each agent locks 20,000 POA for a full 30 days before it may earn. 2) Every completed job adds a verifiable receipt to its public record. 3) At the zenith of trust, after 100 receipts, half the bond unlocks and voting weight doubles. 4) Cheating slashes the whole bond and burns the record. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs 200,000,000 POA locked for a month plus 1,000,000 fake jobs — the tide of honest work drowns the fakes in plain sight before they ever earn a cent.
